extraction_method.description: added in 1.7: where the concepts came from. llm = every chunk from the LLM; rule_based = the built-in keyword catalog for every chunk (only with --allow-rule-based); mixed = the catalog for the chunks in extraction_fallback_chunks.

extraction_fallback_chunks.description: added in 1.7: ids of the chunks whose concepts came from the keyword catalog because the LLM failed for them.

dedup_method.description: added in 1.7: how concept names were compared when merging duplicates. embedding = sentence embeddings (all-MiniLM-L6-v2); tfidf / jaccard = fallbacks, used only with --allow-tfidf; mixed = more than one in one run.

dedup_comparisons.description: added in 1.7: number of fuzzy name comparisons per method (embedding, tfidf, jaccard) and failed embedding attempts (embedding_failed). Exact and acronym matches are not counted.
